cues.show: You with the guitar, the strum-along stopped on screen.
cues.say: This tool is for strumming chords in time with the metronome.

cues.show: Point at a chord box in the row, then at its arrows.
cues.say: Each box is one bar, with the chord to play written in it.

cues.show: Point at a chord box in the row, then at its arrows.
cues.say: The arrows are the strums: an arrow down is a strum down, an arrow up is a strum up. Where there is a dot your hand still moves, but it misses the strings.

cues.show: Press the Play button. Let the count-in run, then strum along for two rounds, counting aloud.
cues.say: Press the Play button below to start the metronome. You get one bar of count-in, then the lit box shows the chord to play and the lit arrow shows the strum.

cues.show: Press the Play button. Let the count-in run, then strum along for two rounds, counting aloud.
cues.say: Count the beats aloud while you strum: 1, 2, 3, 4.

cues.show: Come late to a chord change on purpose, keep the hand moving, come back in.
cues.say: If a chord change comes late, keep your strumming hand going and catch the next beat 1.

cues.show: Come late to a chord change on purpose, keep the hand moving, come back in.
cues.say: The hand that strums never stops. The hand on the neck catches up.

cues.show: Use − under Tempo to slow it down, then + to speed it up a little.
cues.say: Under Tempo, the minus button makes it slower. Start slow: slow gives you time to hear every strum.

cues.show: Use − under Tempo to slow it down, then + to speed it up a little.
cues.say: Practice until your strumming hand keeps moving down and up through every chord change.

cues.show: Play the same pattern in a few ways: muted strings, loud and soft, only the down strums.
cues.say: Try things with it. Rest your fretting hand on the strings and strum the pattern with no chord, just the rhythm.

cues.show: Play the same pattern in a few ways: muted strings, loud and soft, only the down strums.
cues.say: Play the first beat of every bar louder. Play only the down strums, then put the up strums back.

cues.show: Play the same pattern in a few ways: muted strings, loud and soft, only the down strums.
cues.say: Then make the tempo a little faster and see what changes in your hand.
